Powerful, Yet Safe

Omnidirectional obstacle sensing in every direction, paired with a forward-facing LiDAR that still sees in near-darkness — down to around 1 lux. Add Nightscape sensing for confident low-light flying and ActiveTrack 360° to keep your subject framed while the drone flies the path.

Forward LiDAR — ~1 lux

Sees obstacles in near-darkness where normal vision sensors struggle, for safer night and dusk flights.

Nightscape sensing

Omnidirectional sensing tuned for low light, so obstacle avoidance doesn't switch off when the light drops.

ActiveTrack 360°

Locks onto people, bikes and vehicles and tracks smoothly from any angle while you focus on the shot.

Camera

1-inch
pro camera

This is not a “mini” camera.

A 50MP 1-inch CMOS sensor behind a fast f/1.8 lens — the largest sensor ever fitted to a drone this small. It records 4K/60fps HDR with up to 14 stops of dynamic range, plus 4K/120fps slow motion.

  • 10-bit colour for real grading — grade D-Log M / HLG footage properly instead of baked-in colour.
  • 48mm medium-tele crop mode — compresses distance and isolates subjects without a second lens.
  • Better low-light from the bigger sensor — cleaner dawn, dusk and night shots with less noise.
Camera specsSee the gimbal

Gimbal · Vertical video

A gimbal that
turns sideways

The gimbal rotates up to 225°, so the camera itself turns for true vertical shooting — not a cropped, lower-quality slice of a horizontal frame.

  • 225° rotation for creative rolls and true vertical framing.
  • True native vertical video — full quality, no crop, made for Reels & TikTok.
  • Shoot once, post everywhere — capture vertical and horizontal from the same flight.

FAQ

Questions, answered honestly

Tap a question to open it. Tap again to close it.

At 249.9 g (±4 g) it sits in the sub-250g class in many countries — but units can weigh marginally over, rules differ by country, and the Plus battery takes it over 250 g. Always check your local rules before you fly. In Nigeria, check NCAA requirements.

Rated up to 36 minutes in lab conditions (up to 52 minutes with the Plus battery). Real-world mixed flying is less — plan around roughly two-thirds of the rated figure, especially in wind or when recording the whole flight.

Yes. The gimbal rotates up to 225°, so you get native, full-quality vertical video — not a crop from a horizontal frame. Shoot once and post everywhere.

You can still fly and shoot. The Mini 5 Pro has 42GB of internal storage, so a forgotten memory card never cancels a shoot — record to the drone and transfer afterwards.

Small enough to carry everywhere. Serious enough to post anywhere.

249.9 g, a 1-inch 50MP camera, true vertical video and up to 36 minutes per standard battery — from $759.
